## Definition of Ready Checklist
- [ ] User story is clearly written and understood
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are defined and testable
- [ ] Story is estimated (story points assigned)
- [ ] Dependencies are identified and resolved
- [ ] Design/mockups are available (if needed)
- [ ] Technical approach is understood
- [ ] Performance criteria defined (if applicable)
- [ ] Security considerations reviewed (if applicable)

## Definition of Done Checklist

- [ ] Manual testing completed
- [ ] Documentation updated

- [ ] Feature deployed to staging environment
- [ ] Product Owner acceptance obtained
